findings.title: A single long entry stops scrolling forever once auto-advance was switched on, and the disabled control cannot undo it
findings.evidence: loop={!autoAdvance || entry === null} while autoAdvance survives a file switch. Browser: enable Auto-advance on a 3-entry file, switch to a 1-entry long file: button 'Auto-advance: On', disabled, aria-pressed true; animation running:1 then finished:1 at translateX(-514px), still parked at 17 s; nothing rotates or repeats. No vitest case covers it.
findings.consequence: The entry is parked at its tail with no way to restart it except reload or file switch; contradicts the stated rule that a scrolling entry repeats when the timed advance is not rotating.
findings.minimal_fix: loop={!(autoAdvance && entryCount >= 2) || entry === null} (or reset autoAdvance when entries < 2) and add a vitest case.

findings.title: Reduced-motion path is unreadable in layout 1 with classic scrollbars
findings.evidence: overflowX:'auto' on the 18.4 px entry; with Chromium scrollbars not hidden, offsetHeight - clientHeight = 15, clientHeight = 3 at 1280x720 and 1024x768 in layout 1; screenshot shows only a scrollbar. Hidden-scrollbar headless runs and the live check do not see it.
findings.consequence: A vertical clip (forbidden by R12 and the REQ-037 marquee rule) for readers who request reduced motion on desktops with visible scrollbars.
findings.minimal_fix: Use overflow-x:auto with scrollbar-width:none/thin so no height is lost, or fall back to the wrapped, vertically scrolling box for reduced motion.

findings.title: Remaining live findings are four kinds, not two
findings.evidence: After the change: visible dropdown trigger (000628), silent-clip on section.stage-notes-strip (scroll 519x33 in 519x26, follows from the trigger), tooltip not-clipped (phase-wbf-14), and popover 'Choose a file' not-starved (HTML Viewer, 000117 / phase-wbf-13); all four exist on the base. The active-entry finding (441x71, 334x106 boxes) is gone: pass=14 fail=4, 8 findings vs base pass=12 fail=6, 10 findings.
findings.consequence: No effect on this phase; the gate record would otherwise misname the residue.
findings.minimal_fix: Record all four residual kinds with their owners.

findings.title: Image entries are thumbnail-sized in layout 1
findings.evidence: 1024x768 svg renders 436.7x18.4 (1280) and 330x18.4 (1024); minHeight 1.4em makes the 18.4 px entry taller than the 13 px padded row content. Layout 2 renders 329x205 correctly; no overflow, no page scroll.
findings.consequence: R14 met literally; the owner sees an unreadable image in layout 1.
findings.minimal_fix: State in the sizing rule that images are meant for layout 2 or a taller slot.

findings.title: Notices scroll as a ticker in layout 1 and entry textContent is doubled
findings.evidence: Mixed-file rejection renders data-notes-variant=ticker in layout 1; image notices have textContent such as 'No images in docs.No images in docs.' (aria-hidden measurer plus visible text).
findings.consequence: Cosmetic; text-extraction tools and textContent-based tests see duplicates.
findings.minimal_fix: Optional: render notices without the ticker, keep the measurer outside the entry box.

findings.title: Inline styles override the stylesheet's overflow rule
findings.evidence: ENTRY_BOX_STYLE sets overflow:hidden inline over .stage-notes-strip__current { overflow-y: auto } in StagePage.css; no clash, inline wins; StagePage.css is not a deliverable.
findings.consequence: A later edit to that CSS overflow rule will silently have no effect.
findings.minimal_fix: None required; note for a later CSS pass.
